title: Give the live canary's child the compat configuration Pi resolves for a custom provider
statement: Carry the `compat` configuration Pi resolves for the selected custom-provider model into the live canary child's provider configuration, so the canary sends the request this project's Pi sends and the compatibility record describes that request. `customProviderConfig` in `lib/launch-checks.mjs` builds the child's configuration from the resolved model without `compat`, and `lib/pi-provider-canary.mjs` refuses a configuration that carries it, so a provider that declares `compat` is checked with a different request than the one it is launched with. Only the non-credential configuration crosses: `apiKey`, `headers`, `authHeader` and any credential-bearing nested value stay out of the child.
notes: Created 2026-09-24. Commit 8ab0b16 removed `compat` from the TSK-0062 provider fixture because the canary could not carry it to its child. The compatibility key already includes the resolved `compat` through `projectRequestProfile`, so a changed `compat` already changes the key. What is missing is that the canary's proof is taken with `compat` absent, so a record can claim a request profile the canary did not send. Pi merges `compat` from the provider block, the model definition and `modelOverrides`, so the child receives the merged value Pi resolved, not a re-derivation from `models.json`. ⚠️ IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0147, commits b267beb and 529e5db). ACC-0117 has its evidence and awaits review. ⚠️ ACCEPTED 2026-09-25: ACC-0117 passes on EVD-0147.
